Frequently asked questions

Are refurbished iPhones from Swappie authentic?

iPhones refurbished by Swappie are authentic. All phones go through a 52-stage technical process to ensure that every iPhone arrives in good condition.

How good are refurbished iPhones from Swappie?

The appearance of the iPhone that you'll get will vary depending on the grade you choose, but all iPhones from Swappie are unlocked, fully tested, and work like new.

How long is the warranty on Swappie refurbished iPhones?

iPhones refurbished by Swappie also come with a 12-month warranty. We also guarantee a safe and secure purchase with a 14-day return policy.

Can I trust Swappie?

Yes. Our website is safe and secure and if for any reason our product doesn't live up to your expectations, you have up to 14 days to return it, no questions asked. You can have absolute peace of mind when buying a refurbished iPhone from Swappie.

Get the tech you love without the compromise. When you buy a refurbished iPhone from Swappie, you’re choosing a device that looks, feels, and performs like new, but at a price that actually makes sense. We don’t just resell phones; we master them. Every Apple refurbished iPhone in our shop is handled end-to-end by our own experts, ensuring a genuinely trustworthy alternative to buying new. In a world where tech can be complicated, we keep it refreshingly real.

Why choose Swappie for your next iPhone?

Trust is earned, and we aim to earn it with every device we ship. Whether you are looking for an unlocked refurbished iPhone or the latest flagship model, here is why millions of customers join the Swappie fan club:

  • Expertly tested: every device undergoes our rigorous inspection process. From battery health and screen responsiveness to camera precision and microphone clarity, our in-house technicians ensure everything works perfectly.
  • Reliability you can count on: forget the guesswork of buying “used.” We provide a 12-month warranty and a 14-day right to return with no questions asked. We are so confident in our process that we guarantee every phone functions like new.
  • Eco-friendly impact: choosing a refurbished Apple iPhone extends the life of premium technology and significantly reduces the environmental footprint compared to manufacturing a new device. It is a choice you can feel good about.
  • Straightforward value: we offer top-tier tech at a price that won’t break the bank. With models ranging from the latest tech to timeless classics, there is a perfect match for every lifestyle.

Our process is our proof

We control every element of the journey to ensure quality people can count on every day.

  1. Technical audit: expertly refurbished and inspected by experts.
  2. In-house refurbishment: any necessary improvements or repairs are made by our own professionals in our labs—never outsourced to third parties.
  3. Sanitisation: your iPhone refurbished arrives clean, polished, and ready for its new owner.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) 

1. Why should I choose a refurbished iPhone over a new one?

Choosing a refurbished iPhone is a smart move for both your wallet and the planet. You can save up to 40% compared to the original retail price while getting a device that has been professionally tested to work exactly like new. Additionally, buying refurbished extends the life of a high-quality product, reducing electronic waste and the environmental impact of manufacturing new phones.

2. What is the battery health like on a refurbished iPhone?

Battery performance is a top priority at Swappie. Every iPhone undergoes a rigorous testing process to ensure the battery operates at peak capacity. All our standard devices come with a battery capacity of at least 86%. If you want the longest possible lifespan, you can select the “100% Brand New Battery” upgrade at checkout for selected models.

3. What does the 12-month Swappie Warranty™ cover?

We stand behind our quality. Every iPhone includes a comprehensive 12-month warranty, providing the same peace of mind you’d get with a new phone. It covers all technical and hardware defects, such as issues with the display, camera, speakers, or internal components. If something goes wrong, we’ll repair or replace your device quickly.

4. How do you define the condition grades (Like New, Very Good, Good)?

Our grading system refers only to the aesthetic appearance of the phone; internally, every device is 100% functional and tested.
Like New: The phone has no visible marks or scratches. It looks pristine.
Very Good: May have very light signs of wear, such as faint scratches that are hard to see.
Good: Has visible scratches or minor dents on the frame. This is the best-price option for those who plan to use a case anyway.

5. Which iPhone model should I choose?

The right choice depends on your specific needs:
Best Value: The iPhone 13 or iPhone 12 offer modern features like 5G and OLED screens at an excellent price point.
Photography Pros: Look for the “Pro” series (e.g., iPhone 14 Pro or 15 Pro) for triple-lens systems, ProRAW, and advanced zoom.
Large Screen & Battery: The “Max” models (e.g., 14 Pro Max, 15 Pro Max) are perfect for heavy media consumption and gaming.
Compact Design: The iPhone 13 mini or iPhone SE (2022) are ideal for comfortable one-handed use.

6. Will I receive a charger and the original box?

To reduce environmental waste and keep prices as low as possible, we ship our iPhones in a custom-designed, sustainable Swappie box. It includes a high-quality charging cable. While wall adapters are not included, you can easily add one to your order during the checkout process.

7. What if I’m not satisfied with my purchase?

We want you to love your new phone. If you change your mind for any reason, we offer a 14-day free return policy. You can notify us within 14 days of receiving your device and return it within the following 14 days for a full refund.
